name: EOD · Editor of Doom
tagline: Build classic Doom maps in the browser and play them with one tap.
overview: EOD (Editor of Doom) is a free website for building classic Doom maps in the browser and playing them with one tap on a phone, a PC (keyboard and mouse) or a controller. It has a Doom Builder-style editor with a 3D view, monster and weapon generators built on painted Doom-style art, seven demo maps, all 68 free Freedoom maps, and a community map library with forums. Everything runs in your own browser. Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with id Software, Bethesda or ZeniMax.

capabilities.title: No-sign-in front page
capabilities.text: One page to play a quick demo, create a monster or weapon, edit a map, see the maps or open Pulse Forge. No sign-in, no install.

proofs.caption: Front page: six big buttons and the seven demo maps

capabilities.title: Seven demo maps
capabilities.text: Hangar of Shit, Voodoo Express, Glass Gallery, King of Shit Hill, Kev's Water Plant Concept, Chaingun Carnage and Bestiary Arena, each with ▶ Play or ✎ Open in editor.

proofs.caption: ▶ Play Hangar of Shit: straight into the game
King of Shit Hill: the summit over the valley
Kev's Water Plant Concept: the green sludge intake

capabilities.title: 68 free Freedoom maps
capabilities.text: The complete Freedoom Phase 1 and Phase 2 campaigns (BSD licence), each with ▶ Play and ✎ Open.

proofs.caption: The Freedoom list on the front page (Phase 2 and Phase 1)
▶ Play MAP01: the map runs in the browser

capabilities.title: Map editor with 3D Visual mode
capabilities.text: An editor laid out like Ultimate Doom Builder: Vertices, Linedefs, Sectors, Things modes, drawing tools, doors, lifts, stairs, prefabs, Map Analysis, and a 3D Visual mode where you aim at a surface and change it.

proofs.caption: Glass Gallery open in the editor (2D)
3D Visual mode on the same map, with the surface buttons along the bottom

capabilities.title: Monster generator
capabilities.text: Pick a painted creature (74 in the library), recolor it, size it and set its health, speed and attacks; every part has its own reroll.

proofs.caption: Monster generator with a painted creature and its full animation sequence

capabilities.title: Weapon generator
capabilities.text: Pick a painted gun or blade (61 in the library), recolor it and set damage, fire rate and power.

proofs.caption: Weapon generator with a painted heavy repeater and its muzzle flash

capabilities.title: Pulse Forge art
capabilities.text: Creatures cut in Pulse Forge on the same device show up in the generators' Painted art list, marked ⚒.

proofs.caption: A demo creature made in Pulse Forge, picked as ⚒ Demo Baron in the monster generator

capabilities.title: Glass panes
capabilities.text: Any two-sided line can be glass: see-through, tinted, reflective, breakable, with quick looks like Mirror, Frosted, Stained and Bulletproof.

proofs.caption: Glass Gallery: painted monsters behind clear, frosted and stained glass

capabilities.title: Horde maps with waves
capabilities.text: Maps can hand you a starting loadout and send monsters in waves (Chaingun Carnage: six waves, 156 monsters).

proofs.caption: Chaingun Carnage: 999 bullets and the first horde coming up the canyon

capabilities.title: Classic Doom status bar and the marine's face
capabilities.text: The full Doom bar (ammo, health, arms, armor, keys, ammo table) with the marine's face that bleeds, looks toward whoever shot you and grins at a new gun. Classic, Compact or Slim.

proofs.caption: The classic bar with the marine face at full health

capabilities.title: Touch controls
capabilities.text: Move stick, LOOK stick, ⟲ turn-around, FIRE, USE, WPN and MAP, movable with Arrange; they hide when a keyboard, mouse or controller is used.

proofs.caption: In game: move stick (left), LOOK stick, ⟲, FIRE, USE, WPN, MAP

capabilities.title: Forums
capabilities.text: Five categories (Announcements, Show Off Your Maps, Mapping Help, Bugs & Feedback, General) with threads, replies, pin/lock for admins and Report.

proofs.caption: The forum categories (reading needs no account; posting does)

capabilities.title: Pulse standards: look picker, manual, invert, settings
capabilities.text: First visit asks for a look (Light, Dark, Follow device); 👻 manual, ◐ invert and the ⚙ settings on every page.

capabilities.title: Keyboard, mouse and controller with remapping
capabilities.text: Keyboard + mouse with pointer lock, Xbox/standard controllers with rumble, and a full remapping screen saved on the device.

capabilities.title: Voodoo dolls and conveyors
capabilities.text: Vanilla voodoo-doll rules and Boom conveyor lines (251–253), shown in Voodoo Express.

capabilities.title: Kill triggers
capabilities.text: When a marked monster dies, floors change, water starts or stops flowing, lights change, doors open and waves are released (Kev's Water Plant).

capabilities.title: Open any map
capabilities.text: Open a .wad, an /idgames .zip or a .pk3 and play or edit any map in it, with an import report; your own IWAD stays in your browser.

capabilities.title: WAD and playable exports
capabilities.text: Export a WAD (custom textures, generated monsters and weapons included for GZDoom) or a playable HTML file.

capabilities.title: Your own walls and floors
capabilities.text: Add your own pictures as wall or floor textures; they are saved inside the map and exported with it.

capabilities.title: Vanilla limits check
capabilities.text: Optional live counters for visplanes, drawsegs and sprites, plus a whole-map scan that finds where original Doom would crash.

capabilities.title: Map library: publish, versions, play, remix, votes
capabilities.text: Publish maps with permissions (remix allowed, WAD download allowed, draft), keep the last 20 versions, play from the library, remix with credit, vote and report.

capabilities.title: Accounts and admin tools
capabilities.text: Free sign-up, profile, My maps, and an admin reports queue.

note: Captured in headless Chrome at 1920×1080 on a local copy of the site, in Local test mode (no live server, nothing sent anywhere). Proofs that need an account, a WAD file or real gameplay input are still coming.
